mapper.select: select * from users where login_id=#{login_id} and password=#{password}

select c.coach_idx, u.user_idx, u.user_name, c.nickname, c.phone, u.created_at, u.status, (select count(*) from cert c_sub where c_sub.user_idx = c.user_idx and cert_status = '대기') as cert_wait_count from coach c join users u on c.user_idx = u.user_idx order by u.created_at desc
select count(*) from cert where cert_type = '자격증' and cert_status = '대기'
select u.user_name, c.nickname, u.login_id, u.password, c.kakao_key, c.mail, c.birth_date, c.phone, c.photo from coach c join users u on c.user_idx = u.user_idx where u.user_idx=#{user_idx}
select status from users where user_idx=#{user_idx}
select * from (select * from EMBEDDED_USER where user_idx=#{user_idx} order by embed_user_idx desc) where rownum=1
mapper.update: update users set status=#{status} where user_idx=#{user_idx}
update embedded_user set end_date=trunc(sysdate) where embed_user_idx= (select max(embed_user_idx) from embedded_user where user_idx=#{user_idx})
mapper.select: select cert_idx,cert_name,cert_file from cert where user_idx=#{user_idx} and cert_status='대기'
select cert_name,cert_from,get_date,cert_status from cert where user_idx=#{user_idx} and (cert_status='승인' or cert_status='반려') order by cert_status desc
select keyword_type,count(*) as cnt from keyword group by keyword_type order by keyword_type asc
select coach_idx from coach where user_idx=#{user_idx}

select q.qna_idx, q.qna_type, q.title, u.user_name, q.created_at from qna q join users u on q.user_idx = u.user_idx
u.user_type='ADMIN' and q.qna_type!='운영정책'
and ( q.title like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or q.qna_type like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or u.user_name like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or q.qna_idx like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
order by q.qna_idx desc
select q.qna_idx,u.user_name,q.qna_type,q.title,q.question,q.created_at from qna q join users u on q.user_idx=u.user_idx where q.qna_idx=#{qna_idx}
mapper.update: update qna set qna_type=#{qna_type}, title=#{title}, question=#{question} where qna_idx=#{qna_idx}
mapper.select:
select q.qna_idx, u.user_name, q.qna_type, q.title, q.created_at, case when a.qna_a_idx is null then '대기' else '완료' end as status from qna q join users u on q.user_idx=u.user_idx left join qna_a a on q.qna_idx= a.qna_idx
(u.user_type='COACH' or u.user_type='COMPANY')
and ( q.title like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or q.qna_type like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or u.user_name like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or (case when a.qna_a_idx is null then '대기' else '완료' end) = #{keyword} )
order by q.qna_idx desc

select q.qna_idx, q.qna_type, q.title as q_title, u.user_name, q.created_at as q_created_at, q.question, a.qna_a_idx, a.title as a_title, a.answer, a.created_at as a_created_at from qna q join users u on q.user_idx=u.user_idx left join qna_a a on q.qna_idx = a.qna_idx where q.qna_idx=#{qna_idx}
mapper.update: update qna_a set title=#{title}, answer=#{answer}, created_at=sysdate where qna_a_idx=#{qna_a_idx}
mapper.select: select * from major_field
select * from minor_field where major_field_idx=#{major_field_idx}
mapper.update: update minor_field set minor_field_nm =#{minor_field_nm} where minor_field_idx=#{minor_field_idx}
mapper.select: select r.report_idx, rt.content, u1.user_name as reporter_name, u2.user_name as reported_name, r.status, r.created_at from report r join users u1 on r.reporter_idx=u1.user_idx join users u2 on r.reported_idx=u2.user_idx join reason_type rt on r.reason_type_idx=rt.reason_type_idx order by report_idx desc

select r.report_idx, rt.content as report_type, r.status, r.created_at, u1.user_name as reporter_name, u1.user_idx as reporter_idx, u2.user_name as reported_name, u2.user_idx as reported_idx, u2.user_type, r.content from report r join users u1 on r.reporter_idx=u1.user_idx join users u2 on r.reported_idx=u2.user_idx join reason_type rt on r.reason_type_idx=rt.reason_type_idx where r.report_idx=#{report_idx}
select coach_idx from coach where user_idx=#{user_idx}
select company_idx from company where user_idx=#{user_idx}
mapper.update: update report set status=#{status},updated_at=sysdate where report_idx=#{report_idx}
mapper.select: select count(*) from users where created_at >= trunc(sysdate) and created_at < trunc(sysdate) + 1 and user_type!='ADMIN'
select count(*) from report where status='WAIT'
select count(*) from users where user_type='COMPANY' and status='INACTIVE'
select sum(p.total)/10000 from pay p join pay_status ps on p.tid=ps.tid where ps.status='완료됨' and p.approved_at >= trunc(sysdate) and p.approved_at < trunc(sysdate) + 1
select sum(p.total) as totals from pay p join pay_status ps on p.tid=ps.tid where ps.status='완료됨' and p.approved_at >= trunc(sysdate,'MM') and p.approved_at < add_months(trunc(sysdate,'MM'),1)
select sum(p.total) as totals from pay p join pay_status ps on p.tid=ps.tid where ps.status='완료됨' and p.approved_at >= add_months(trunc(sysdate,'MM'),-1) and p.approved_at < trunc(sysdate,'MM')

SELECT d.dt AS sales_date, TO_CHAR(d.dt, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS day_name, ROUND(NVL(SUM(p.total), 0) / 10000, 1) AS daily_revenue FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (LEVEL - 1) AS dt FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) d LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT p.tid, p.total, p.approved_at FROM pay p JOIN pay_status ps ON p.tid = ps.tid WHERE ps.status = '완료됨' ) p ON TRUNC(p.approved_at) = d.dt GROUP BY d.dt ORDER BY d.dt ASC
